rationale: Price is at 99% of today's range after a large gap-up of 2.44% and a sharp intraday surge (the last candle shows a high-volume spike from ~165.80 to 168.61 followed by continuation to 169.00), placing it essentially at the session high with no news catalyst to explain the move.
